# `regexp_instr`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Searches a string for a regular expression and returns an integer that indicates the beginning position of the matched substring. Positions are 1-based, not 0-based. If no match is found, returns 0.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
regexp_instr(str, regexp)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- regexp_instr, example 1
> SELECT regexp_instr(r"\abc", r"^\\abc$");
1
```

```sql
-- regexp_instr, example 2
> SELECT regexp_instr('user@spark.apache.org', '@[^.]*');
5
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.4.0.
